units: Ber. 3ᵇ בא … ונוֹשֶׁבֶת בו (Ms. M. ומְנַשֶּׁבֶת Pi.) the north wind came and blew at him.

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:17">Ab. III, 17</cite> <he>אפילו … ונוֹשְׁבוֹת בו</he> even if all the winds of the world came and blew at it (to uproot it) &c.; <cite ref="Taanit 20a">Taan. 20ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:16">Cant. R. to IV, 16</cite>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 111b:6-12">Keth. 111ᵇ</cite> <he>הקב״ה … ומְנַשְּׁבָהּ עליה</he> the Lord brings a wind … and lets it pass over it (the wheat).

senses.gloss: same. מַשִּׁיב הרוח ומוריד הגשם ‘who causes the wind to blow and the rain to descend’, a clause inserted in G’buroth (v. גְּבוּרוֹת) during the winter season.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 3b:4">Taan. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>אמר משיב הרוח אין וכ׳</he> if he said in his prayers, ‘Who causes the wind to blow’ only.
<cite ref="Taanit 24a">Ib. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>אמר מ׳ הרוח וכ׳</he> as soon as he said, ‘Who causes &c.’, a wind arose; a. e.
